maddeler.e:
استقصيت (form X)
# اِسْتَقْصَيْتُ (istaqṣaytu) /is.taq.sˤaj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَقْصَى (istaqṣā)
# اِسْتَقْصَيْتَ (istaqṣayta) /is.taq.sˤaj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَقْصَى (istaqṣā)
# اِسْتَقْصَيْتِ (istaqṣayti) /is.taq.sˤaj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَقْصَى (istaqṣā)
# اُسْتُقْصِيتُ (ustuqṣītu) /us.tuq.sˤiː.
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
